comments.text:
In my opinion, while Singapore is often called "The Pearl of Asia," I believe it deserves to be known as "The Diamond of Asia" for the following reasons:
☀️ It has excellent infrastructure.
☀️ It has highly competent and capable leaders and politicians.
☀️ Singapore is very safe; anyone can go out without worry, whether by day or by night. In my view, it is the safest place to raise a family with peace of mind and security.
☀️ Singapore is constantly progressing.
These are the reasons why it better deserves the title "The Diamond of Asia." I believe all countries should follow Singapore's example so that they, too, can become safe, progressive nations, making the world a better place.
Greetings from Chile.

@KsLeow – Those homes you're referring to aren't built for ordinary Malaysians or the local population. Most can't afford them and instead have to apply for government-subsidized housing—small, matchbox-like units, often built on newly cleared land with poor planning. Many lack basic amenities such as proper garbage collection, nearby schools, markets, and convenient public facilities. My uncle owned one, so I've seen it firsthand.

As for those dream homes in the video, they're largely marketed to wealthy buyers, including Singaporeans and other foreigners. That's why I don't put much trust in such promotional videos.
